spec.title: Span rate
spec.description: Finished spans per second for the connectors, the worker, and the webhook receiver. A gap means no traffic, or Tempo has not remote-written span metrics yet.

spec.title: Span errors
spec.description: Spans per second that finished in error for the connectors, the worker, and the webhook receiver. A gap means no errors.

spec.title: Span duration p95
spec.description: 95th percentile span duration for the connectors, the worker, and the webhook receiver, in seconds.

spec.title: Sync runs
spec.description: Finished connector cycles per second, by source and result. A gap means the connector has not finished a cycle in the window.

spec.title: Watermark lag
spec.description: Now minus the stored watermark, in seconds. A cursor source leaves this unset. Yellow at 30 seconds is the HR contract.

spec.title: Ingest events
spec.description: Events the worker finished or refused, by source and result. invalid is a body the worker would not apply.

spec.title: Queue depth
spec.description: Visible messages on the P0, P1, and P2 queues. This is a gauge. It is not wrapped in increase.

spec.title: Dead-letter depth
spec.description: Visible messages on a tier dead-letter queue. Any message here is a failed change. This is a gauge.

spec.title: Webhook notices
spec.description: Product hook notices accepted, rejected, or refused because SQS did not take them.

spec.title: Hook queue depth
spec.description: Visible messages on the product hook queue or its dead-letter queue. Only the dead-letter queue is a failure.

spec.title: Webhook HTTP rate
spec.description: Requests per second on the webhook receiver, by route. Health and metrics scrapes are left out.

spec.title: Logs
spec.description: JSON lines from the connectors, the worker, and the webhook receiver. source_id is a label when the line has one. trace_id opens the Tempo trace.

spec.title: Recent traces
spec.description: Traces for a connector cycle, a queue consume, or a product hook. An ingestion trace is separate from a later chat question.
